item.tib: khro mchog 'dus pa sde brgyad 'byung po spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las dpal gyi tshe sgrub rdo rje'i gur khang
item.coloph: ces lus sems lha skur grub pa'i 'chi med tshe la dbang ba'i thabs zab mo 'di nyid mdo khams smad kyi gnas mchog brag dkar bya rgod gsang ba'i mdun zhol nyi shar brag gi g.yon zur nor bu rdzong gi byang ngos sked gsang ska rags 'dra ba'i bar nas sa stag lo'i zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gcig gi nyin mor kho bo phyogs med kyi rnal 'byor ba gtsug phud rnam rgyal bdag gis dngos grub tu rnyed nas slar mda' chen dkar mo ri khrod du slebs tshe mkhas pa dmu tsa dra (tra) he'i rnam rol skyang spral nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang lha grogs dam pa rnams dang dad ldan slob ma 'ga' yis bskul ngor shog ser laM zhal bshus pa 'dis kyang g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
